newsitem.title: UK: UK wheat and barley futures close mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: UK wheat and barley futures close mostly lower.

text.p: LIFFE wheat and barley futures closed mostly lower on Tuesday with business confined mainly to switching.
Wheat turnover was low throughout the day and comprised mostly switches between January and March. However towards the close one major player switched a large number of lots.
"A big player came in late in the session and switched 300 lots in January, almost doubling the turnover," said a trader.
At the close wheat futures were 0.20 to 0.90 stg down with only July 1997 bucking the trend at 0.10 stg up.
Most active January last traded at 93.80 stg, 0.20 stg down, on a turnover of 417 lots.
Barley finished 0.40 to 0.15 stg down after trading 42 lots.
The most active position was September which last traded at 92.75 stg, unchanged, with 20 lots against it. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8062
